title: Overlord Banord Paffa
summary: Defeat Banord's puslings and subsequent waves to draw out the overlord.
overview: Defeat Banord's puslings and subsequent waves to draw out the overlord.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Clear the initial puslings to start the timed wave progression.
Hold the room through the minion waves and prepare for Banord to become attackable.
Avoid leaving the final boss idle for an extended period, which can reset the event.
